title: Join three tables
prompt: Show device_name, patient_id, and hospital name for each device order. Join device_orders → patients → hospitals.
hints: Chain JOINs: device_orders to patients, then patients to hospitals.

validation.solutionSql: SELECT device_orders.device_name, device_orders.patient_id, hospitals.name FROM device_orders JOIN patients ON device_orders.patient_id = patients.patient_id JOIN hospitals ON patients.hospital_id = hospitals.hospital_id
